basic_info.description: Welcome to 1469 38th Avenue - a thoughtfully designed single-family residence located in San Francisco's coveted Outer Sunset neighborhood. This exceptional home offers a highly functional floor plan that blends classic charm with modern living. The upper level features a spacious living room with abundant natural light and a working fireplace, a formal dining area, and a large kitchen ideal for both daily living and entertaining. Two well-appointed upstairs bedrooms enjoy stunning ocean views with a full bath. Downstairs, you'll find a serene primary suite complete with a deep soaking bathtub, full bathroom, and an adjacent bonus room perfect for a nursery, home office, or creative studio. The lower level seamlessly flows out to a private deck and landscaped yard, designed by HGTV's Todd Davis, featuring a hot tub and outdoor shower creating a private retreat perfect for relaxation or entertaining. Additional highlights include a dedicated laundry room, one-car garage, ample storage, and thoughtful updates throughout. Ideally located just moments from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and the new Great Highway Park, with easy access to cafes, great schools, and public transit. This is Sunset living at its finest.
